meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会创作或修改多场景视频：先读简报、写分镜，再搭场景、加动效。图片音频特效前会查内部手册；“伴飞”（共同创作）模式下会先出完整方案，再由你删改。
howto.when: 没有更专门的流程可用，且任务是 HyperFrames 视频——较长或多场景，如品牌片、混剪、静态标题卡等——时触发；项目简报 BRIEF.md 写明 flow: companion 时也接管。

say.text: 帮我做一支三个场景的品牌宣传片，先给完整方案。
say.note: 走伴飞模式：Claude 先出整体设计，你删改后再动工。

say.text: 在这个视频项目里，把第 2 个场景加一段镜头混剪。
say.note: 具体编辑：保留已有决定，只改目标场景。

say.text: 做一个十秒的静态标题卡，不要动效。
say.note: 属于静态标题卡类型，按静态输出。

howto.what_en: Claude authors or edits multi-scene HyperFrames videos: reads project state, writes plan/storyboard blocks, builds scenes, adds motion. Media assets go through media-use handbook; companion flow starts from a full design, then builds.
howto.when_en: Triggers for HyperFrames video when no specialized workflow fits—multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static cards, remixes—or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion.

say_en.text: Make a three-scene brand video and give me the full plan first.
say_en.note: Companion flow: full design first, then you trim.

say_en.text: In this video project, add a footage remix to scene 2.
say_en.note: Specific edit: keeps existing decisions, changes only that scene.

say_en.text: Make a 10-second static title card with no animation.
say_en.note: Uses the static title card type; output is static.
